title: Multi-AI Agents Meta-Analysis for Autonomous Self-Improvement: Critical Relativism in Overcoming Predictable Failures of Reinforcement Learning in High-Uncertainty Environments via Quantum-Augmented Self-Adaptive Networks

contributions.purpose: 提出"批判相对主义"多AI智能体元分析方法
contributions.mechanism: 以 Locke/Leibniz/Hegel/Kant 四哲学阶段,汇聚6个AI(Grok/CoPilot/ChatGPT/You/Perplexity/Gemini)对同一 prompt 的回答做四相收敛
contributions.evaluation: 定性:四相流程描述;"响应"实为作者转述(shared links inaccessible)
contributions.domain: AI 自我改进/RL(伪科学拼盘)
contributions.source_quote: A transparent methodology for multi-agent convergence, empirically demonstrating self-improvement in dissecting RL limitations.

contributions.purpose: 识别 SGD/Backprop 在不确定环境的核心失败模式
contributions.mechanism: 对6个AI回答做频率统计,列表给"同意度"百分比
contributions.evaluation: Table1 声称 SGD 非平稳振荡85%、噪声梯度70%、维度诅咒60%;正文另称30%策略退化、40%准确率下降
contributions.source_quote: Identification of core failure modes in SGD and Backpropagation under uncertainty, with meta-analytic evidence from six AI agents.

contributions.purpose: 提出量子增强自适应网络 QASAN
contributions.mechanism: 量子电路 U_Q 使状态-动作叠加 + 自适应反馈回路 f:ΔE→θ 量子梯度下降
contributions.evaluation: "模拟"熵 H=2.1→0.3 bits、探索2-5x加速、韧性+25%(均来自 agent simulations,无真实实验)
contributions.source_quote: Proposal of QASANs—quantum-augmented networks—for adaptive, resilient AI science, achieving the trilemma of agility, resilience, and sustainability unattainable by classical RL.

self_declared_provenance.quote: QASANs extend self-adaptive systems [malhotra2025qasan], integrating quantum principles for uncertainty management.

notes: desk-reject。极低质 buzzword 拼盘(量子+批判相对主义+QASAN),自声明 threefold 已对应 C1-C3。多重数据红旗:(1) 破坏提交完整性——PDF 里同时塞进渲染正文、整段原始 LaTeX 源码,以及"Additional Statements Text/Alternative Titles"编译说明,明显是未清理的 AI 生成物/损坏提交,疑似测试性提交;(2) 造数——"Responses (synthesized from public interfaces, as shared links were inaccessible)"承认6个agent的回答是作者合成/转述而非真实采集;Table1 同意度百分比(85%/70%/60% 等)基于 n=6 却给出精细百分比(85%×6≈5.1个),不可能;(3) QASAN 效能数字(H 2.1→0.3、2-5x、+25%)来自"agent simulations",无真实实验支撑;(4) 循环自证/自引——核心引用 malhotra2025qasan / malhotra2022augmented 均为作者本人 SSRN 未评审预印本且被当作"prior empirical validation";(5) 参考文献细节错误(如 Khetarpal offline RL 配 arXiv:2005.01643 实为 Levine 等;作者名 garbled);(6) Responsible AI 称"Adheres to NeurIPS ethics"而非 Agents4Science,复制粘贴痕迹。checklist AI 披露:Hypothesis 90% AI-led、Coding 100% AI、Writing 85% AI、Review 用 AI 做 co-reviewer。type 主体为 method(方法+QASAN 提案)。
